lines.text: 架子上的小东西放得散？可以用这个收纳盒把它们分开放。
lines.shot: 同一层架子上放着收纳盒和几件散放小物。

lines.text: 先把分隔片取出来，再装回去，把小东西按区放进去。
lines.shot: 俯拍分隔片的取出和装回，再把小物放进两个区域。

lines.text: 先量一下架子。这个盒子的外尺寸是 23 × 15 × 9 厘米。
lines.shot: 用尺子依次量盒子的外长、外宽和外高。

lines.text: Use this organizer to sort the small items on your shelf.
lines.shot: Show loose items and the organizer on the same shelf.

lines.text: Lift out the divider, put it back, and sort the items into sections.
lines.shot: From above, show the divider coming out and going back before sorting the items.

lines.text: Measure your shelf first. The outside dimensions are 23 by 15 by 9 centimeters.
lines.shot: Use a ruler to show each outside measurement.
